desc: The Hell’s Canyon Max LR HD is designed to bridge the gap between long range hunting and precision competition. It has all of the performance-driven features made famous by the X-Bolt, all rolled into a revised action with additional bolt guidance for smoother bolt operation. The lengths of the fluted, heavy sporter contour barrels run 2" longer than standard lengths (to a maximum of 26") for added bullet velocity. The muzzle is belled to accommodate the larger 5/8"-24 suppressor-ready threading. The action is bedded, and the barrel is free floated for consistent accuracy. The X-Bolt 2 Hell's Canyon Max LR HD rifle takes innovation to the next level with its stock design. Correct eye-to-scope alignment is easily achieved via the easy to use adjustable comb. Your personal length of pull is also readily dialed-in with the included spacers. A wider fore-end adds stability from the bench and is also easy to adapt to fit an ARCA/Swiss rail. A hand-applied camouflage finish uses a bronze and gray color palette to blend in to a variety of environments and enhance the visual appeal of the stock.
